newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells nearly all coffee in small auction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells nearly all coffee in small auction.

text.p: The Brazilian government sold 19,994 60-kg bags of coffee in its auction today of 20,023 bags of stocks, said an official from the Banco do Brasil which held the electronic auction.
Prices ranged between 90 and 126.55 reais ($88.62 and $124.61) a bag, with total income from the sale 2.4 million reais ($2.3 million), the official said.
The sale was the second in the 1996/1997 (July/June) and was of a very small quantity given the harvest is underway. The next auction is scheduled to be held Sept 25.
